message: Goal: Create a Python script that fetches a webpage and saves it to a file

"fetch_webpage.py" "import requests\nresponse = requests.get('http://example.com')\nwith open('webpage.html', 'w') as f:\n f.write(response.text)" file-write "python fetch_webpage.py" shell dup "stdout" get print "code" get 0 eq [ "Python script ran successfully" print ] [ "Python script failed to run" print ] if "webpage.html" file-exists [ "Webpage saved successfully" print ] [ "ERROR: Webpage not saved" print ] if "Fetched webpage and saved it to a file." done
